messages:
samir: quick heads up — dashboards for tenant metrics are exploding in latency during peak. looking at slow queries, wide row scans per tenant
maria: can you paste an example query?
samir: here is a sanitized one
```
SELECT tenant_id, metric_name, SUM(value) FROM tenant_metrics WHERE tenant_id IN (...) AND ts >= now()-interval '7 days' GROUP BY tenant_id, metric_name;
```
alex: yep that's the problem. our current model is a single wide table with one row per tenant+metric and a jsonb payload. it serializes poorly for time series and quotas
jess: proposal: move to append-only events for metrics + materialized views for dashboards. dual-write during rollout, shadow-reads for 2 weeks, then backfill and cutover
chen: love the idea but worried about quota calculus and routing. our quota service expects a single canonical counter per tenant. how do we keep it accurate during dual-write?
samir: plan: maintain a canonical counter service that continues to write increments to the old store while we emit events to new event stream and a streaming job updates a counter shard in parallel. counters reconciled nightly
infra-bot: deploy plan template created: deploy/telemetry/migrate-to-events v1 -> canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with dual-write and shadow reads
maria: what about query patterns for ad hoc analytics? many of our console panels do multi-tenant aggregations across tenant groups
alex: materialized views in the analytics DB will be grouped by route_id and metric_name. for cross-tenant queries we keep a pre-aggregated rollup table updated via streaming process. gives fast read for console panels
tal: backfill cost estimate? filling 6 months of events for ~10k tenants may be heavy
samir: rough numbers: ~12TB of raw event data, streaming backfill job can process ~500MB/s using parallel workers, estimate ~24 hours with spot GPUs for compression, but main cost is downstream indexing in materials.
jess: also need schema contract versioning. any field renames must be handled by parsers. suggest a version field on events: schema_v = 1
alex: agree. add header attrs: route_id, origin (EDGE/DEDICATED), sampling_flag, schema_v
chen: routing policies — do we route events to regional clusters? we need to honor tenant region affinity for privacy controls
maria: yes keep region tag and use smart routing. events include region, we shard event topics per region
kevin: consoles will need a migration UX: show 'metrics are transitioning' banner, allow opting out of new view, and an admin toggle to force old vs new
samir: rollout checklist draft:
- add event emission to producer lib (samir)
- streaming transform & materialized views (alex)
- dual-write enabled by feature flag (jess)
- reconciliation job & nightly counters (chen)
- backfill orchestrator + cost estimate (tal)
- console UX banner + toggle (kevin)
- SLO alerting for dashboard latency/regression (maria)

jess: timeline idea: week 1 feature flag and small canary, week 2 increase canary and start shadow reads, week 3 backfill and widened canary, week 4 cutover if metrics stable
samir: outstanding risks: - double-counting in quotas during rollouts - materialized view freshness - storage cost spike during backfill
maria: mitigations: idempotent event dedupe using event_id, reconciliation job that marks discrepant tenants and puts them into a reconciliation queue
chen: for quotas specifically, propose a read-through adapter: during rollouts the quota service reads counters from primary counter store but consults the reconciliation store to adjust if lag > threshold
tal: perf test we should run: simulate tenant with 100k req/min and validate dashboard refresh under dual path
kevin: UX question: do we surface schema_v to customers? i'd rather hide it and only expose 'metrics version' in admin logs
samir: agreed hide internal schema_v. only use in telemetry for us
jess: ok i'll create a PR template with required migration fields and schema docs. will link infra-bot once ready
infra-bot: PR: PR#nodejs/telemetry/567 opened by jess
maria: thanks. can we set an onboarding doc for SRE on rollback steps? last time rollback required manual counter compaction
alex: will document rollback: disable dual-write flag, run reconciliation to compact counters, reindex materialized views
samir: cool. owners assigned. let's sync tomorrow 10am to lock timeline. :thumbsup:
kevin: +1
chen: thanks everyone
